turns.en: Hi there! How are you doing today?
turns.cn: 嗨！你今天过得怎么样？

turns.en: I'm doing great, thanks! How about you?
turns.cn: 我很好，谢谢！你呢？
turns.tip: 说的时候语气要轻快，「How about you?」是自然的回问方式。

turns.en: Pretty good. The weather is nice today, isn't it?
turns.cn: 挺好的。今天天气不错，对吧？

turns.en: Yes, it's really sunny. I love this kind of weather.
turns.cn: 是的，阳光很好。我很喜欢这种天气。
turns.tip: 「sunny」和「weather」发音要清晰，表达喜欢时语气可以热情一点。

turns.en: Me too. Do you have any plans for the weekend?
turns.cn: 我也是。你周末有什么计划吗？

turns.en: Not really. I might just relax at home and read a book.
turns.cn: 没什么特别的。我可能就在家休息看看书。
turns.tip: 「Not really」表示「没什么特别的」，说得轻松自然一点。

turns.en: That sounds nice. What kind of books do you like?
turns.cn: 听起来不错。你喜欢什么类型的书？

turns.en: I like novels, especially mystery stories.
turns.cn: 我喜欢小说，尤其是推理小说。
turns.tip: 「especially」重音在第二个音节，用来强调你最喜欢的东西。

turns.en: Oh, I enjoy those too. Do you read every day?
turns.cn: 哦，我也喜欢。你每天都看书吗？

turns.en: Yes, I try to read for at least thirty minutes before bed.
turns.cn: 是的，我尽量每天睡前至少看三十分钟。
turns.tip: 「try to」表示「尽量」，让语气听起来很随和；「before bed」是简单常用的短语。

turns.en: That's a good habit. Well, it was nice chatting with you!
turns.cn: 这是个好习惯。好啦，很高兴和你聊天！

turns.en: Nice chatting with you too. Have a great day!
turns.cn: 我也很高兴和你聊天。祝你今天愉快！
turns.tip: 「Have a great day!」是日常告别金句，记得说得真诚、面带微笑。

turns.en: Good morning. Please have a seat and tell me a little about yourself.
turns.cn: 早上好。请坐，简单介绍一下你自己。

turns.en: Good morning. I am a marketing specialist with five years of experience in digital campaigns.
turns.cn: 早上好。我是一名市场营销专员，有五年数字营销活动的经验。
turns.tip: 保持微笑，自信地说出你的职位和经验，重点强调「years of experience」。

turns.en: That sounds great. Why do you want to leave your current job?
turns.cn: 听起来不错。你为什么想离开现在的工作？

turns.en: I am looking for new challenges and opportunities to grow my skills in a larger team.
turns.cn: 我在寻找新的挑战，并希望在一个更大的团队中提升技能。
turns.tip: 避免批评前公司，用「looking for new challenges」表达积极态度。

turns.en: I see. What do you know about our company and this role?
turns.cn: 明白了。你对我们公司和这个职位有什么了解？

turns.en: I know your company values innovation, and I believe my background fits this position very well.
turns.cn: 我知道贵公司重视创新，而且我相信我的背景非常适合这个职位。
turns.tip: 展示你做过功课，使用「values innovation」和「fits this position」。

turns.en: Could you describe a difficult situation at work and how you handled it?
turns.cn: 你能描述一下工作中遇到的困难以及你是如何处理的吗？

turns.en: Once we faced a tight deadline, so I organized a team meeting and we finished the project early.
turns.cn: 有一次我们面临紧迫的截止日期，所以我组织了一次团队会议，最终提前完成了项目。
turns.tip: 用「once we faced...」开头讲故事，强调解决问题的结果。

turns.en: Teamwork is important here. How do you usually collaborate with others?
turns.cn: 在这里团队合作很重要。你通常如何与他人协作？

turns.en: I prefer open communication and regular updates to make sure everyone stays on the same page.
turns.cn: 我喜欢开放的沟通和定期的进度更新，以确保每个人的信息都保持一致。
turns.tip: 用「open communication」和「stays on the same page」来体现团队精神。

turns.en: Do you have any questions for me before we wrap up?
turns.cn: 在我们结束之前，你有什么问题要问我吗？

turns.en: Yes. Could you tell me about the training opportunities for new employees?
turns.cn: 有的。您能告诉我新员工有哪些培训机会吗？
turns.tip: 面试结尾提问显示兴趣，用「training opportunities」自然收尾。

turns.en: Welcome to our hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
turns.cn: 欢迎来到我们酒店。您在我们这里有预订吗？

turns.en: Yes, I booked a room for two nights under the name Li Wei.
turns.cn: 是的，我订了一间住两晚的房间，名字是李伟。
turns.tip: 清晰说出预订姓名，注意 under the name 后接拼音或英文名。

turns.en: Perfect, I found it. Here is your room key. Breakfast is from seven to ten on the second floor.
turns.cn: 好的，我找到了。这是您的房卡。早餐在二楼，七点到十点供应。

turns.en: Thank you. Could you tell me where the nearest subway station is?
turns.cn: 谢谢。您能告诉我最近的地铁站在哪里吗？
turns.tip: Could you tell me... 是非常礼貌的问路说法，句尾记得用升调。

turns.en: Sure. Go straight for two blocks and turn left. You will see it next to the coffee shop.
turns.cn: 当然。直走两个街区然后左转。你会在咖啡店旁边看到它。

turns.en: Is there a good place to eat nearby? I would like to try some local food.
turns.cn: 这附近有什么吃饭的好地方吗？我想尝尝当地美食。
turns.tip: would like to 比 want 更客气，适合向酒店工作人员询问。

turns.en: There is a popular restaurant just around the corner. I recommend their seafood noodles.
turns.cn: 拐角处就有一家很受欢迎的餐厅。我推荐他们家的海鲜面。

turns.en: That sounds great. What time does it close tonight?
turns.cn: 听起来不错。他们今晚几点关门？
turns.tip: 询问营业时间用 What time does it open/close? 注意 does 的位置。

turns.en: It closes at ten. Would you like me to call a taxi for you?
turns.cn: 他们十点关门。需要我帮您叫辆出租车吗？

turns.en: No, thanks. I think I will walk there and enjoy the city view.
turns.cn: 不用了，谢谢。我想步行过去，欣赏一下城市风景。
turns.tip: enjoy the view 是常用搭配，表示欣赏风景，语气轻松自然即可。

turns.en: Good idea. If you need any help, feel free to ask the front desk anytime.
turns.cn: 好主意。如果您需要任何帮助，随时都可以问前台。

turns.en: I will. Thanks for your help. Have a nice evening.
turns.cn: 我会的。谢谢您的帮助。祝您晚上愉快。
turns.tip: Have a nice evening 是结束对话的礼貌用语，记得微笑发音。

turns.en: Thank you all for coming. Let's get started by reviewing the agenda for today's meeting.
turns.cn: 感谢大家前来。让我们先过一下今天的会议议程。

turns.en: Thanks for having me. I'm ready to discuss the quarterly sales report.
turns.cn: 感谢您的邀请。我已准备好讨论季度销售报告。
turns.tip: 语气要专业且自信，可以说 「I'm ready to...」来表明准备就绪。

turns.en: Great. Could you walk us through the key highlights and any challenges you faced last quarter?
turns.cn: 很好。能否请您过一下主要亮点以及上季度遇到的挑战？

turns.en: Overall revenue grew by fifteen percent, but we did encounter some supply chain delays in March.
turns.cn: 整体收入增长了百分之十五，但我们在三月份确实遇到了一些供应链延迟问题。
turns.tip: 用 「but we did encounter」来委婉引出问题，保持客观语气。

turns.en: That sounds promising. How do you plan to mitigate those supply chain risks moving forward?
turns.cn: 听起来很有希望。您计划如何在未来降低这些供应链风险？

turns.en: We are diversifying our supplier base and negotiating longer-term contracts to ensure stability.
turns.cn: 我们正在使供应商基础多元化，并谈判更长期的合同以确保稳定。
turns.tip: 使用 「diversifying」和 「negotiating」等动名词来展示具体行动计划。

turns.en: Good strategy. Let's also touch on the marketing budget—are we on track to meet our year-end targets?
turns.cn: 策略不错。我们再谈一下营销预算——我们有望实现年终目标吗？

turns.en: We are slightly under budget so far, which gives us room to invest in the new digital campaign next month.
turns.cn: 到目前为止我们略低于预算，这让我们有余地下个月投资新的数字营销活动。
turns.tip: 「under budget」是地道表达，用 「gives us room to」说明灵活性。

turns.en: Excellent. What is the projected timeline for launching that campaign, and who will be the point person?
turns.cn: 很好。推出该活动的预计时间表是什么，谁将担任负责人？

turns.en: We aim to launch by mid-October, and I will be the main point of contact for the team.
turns.cn: 我们计划在十月中旬前推出，我将作为团队的主要联系人。
turns.tip: 「aim to launch」体现目标感，「point of contact」是商务常用语。

turns.en: Perfect. Let's schedule a follow-up two weeks from now to check on the progress. Does that work for everyone?
turns.cn: 很好。我们安排两周后的跟进会议来检查进展。这对大家都方便吗？

turns.en: That works for me. I'll send out a summary and the action items by end of day today.
turns.cn: 我没问题。我会在今天下班前发出一份摘要和行动事项。
turns.tip: 用 「That works for me」表示同意，「action items」是会议常用词。

turns.en: Hi there! Welcome to our restaurant. How many people are in your party tonight?
turns.cn: 您好！欢迎光临我们餐厅。请问今晚几位用餐？

turns.en: There are two of us. Could we get a table near the window?
turns.cn: 我们两位。可以给我们一张靠窗的桌子吗？
turns.tip: 用 Could we get...? 来礼貌地提出请求，注意句尾语调上扬。

turns.en: Sure thing. Right this way. Here are your menus.
turns.cn: 没问题。请这边走。这是你们的菜单。

turns.en: Thanks a lot. What would you recommend?
turns.cn: 非常感谢。你有什么推荐的吗？
turns.tip: 询问推荐时说 What would you recommend?，注意连读和语调。

turns.en: The grilled salmon is our special today. Would you like to try it?
turns.cn: 烤三文鱼是今天的特色菜。您想尝尝吗？

turns.en: That sounds delicious. I'll have the grilled salmon, please.
turns.cn: 听起来很美味。我要一份烤三文鱼，谢谢。
turns.tip: 用 I'll have... 来点餐，既自然又地道，记得加 please。

turns.en: Excellent choice. What would you like to drink?
turns.cn: 选得真好。您想喝点什么？

turns.en: I'll just have a glass of water with ice, please.
turns.cn: 我只要一杯加冰的水，谢谢。
turns.tip: I'll just have... 表示我只要……，语气轻松且礼貌。

turns.en: Got it. I'll bring that out right away.
turns.cn: 好的。我马上把水端过来。

turns.en: Excuse me, could I also order a side of French fries?
turns.cn: 打扰一下，我可以再点一份薯条吗？
turns.tip: 想加菜时用 Could I also...?，记得先说 Excuse me 引起注意。

turns.en: Of course. I'll add it to your order. Would you like anything else?
turns.cn: 当然。我帮您加上。还需要别的吗？

turns.en: No, that's everything. Thank you so much.
turns.cn: 不用了，就这些。非常感谢。
turns.tip: That's everything. 是表示就这些了的常用说法，适合结束点餐。

turns.en: Welcome! Are you looking for anything in particular today?
turns.cn: 欢迎！您今天想找点什么？

turns.en: Yes, I like this jacket. How much is it?
turns.cn: 是的，我喜欢这件夹克。多少钱？
turns.tip: 用友好的语气问价格，可以说 「How much is this?」

turns.en: It's $80. It's made of real leather and very popular this season.
turns.cn: 八十美元。这是真皮的，而且这季很流行。

turns.en: That's a bit expensive. Can you give me a better price?
turns.cn: 有点贵。能给我便宜点吗？
turns.tip: 用委婉语气说 「a bit expensive」，然后问 「Can you give me a better price?」

turns.en: I can take $5 off, but that's the best I can do.
turns.cn: 我可以减五美元，但这是最优惠的价格了。

turns.en: I really like it, but my budget is only $65. Would that work?
turns.cn: 我真的很喜欢，但我的预算只有六十五美元。这样可以吗？
turns.tip: 用 「my budget is...」 来表明预算，语气要诚恳。

turns.en: $65 is too low. How about we meet in the middle at $70?
turns.cn: 六十五太低了。各退一步，七十美元怎么样？

turns.en: $70 is still a little high. Could you make it $68 and I'll take it right now?
turns.cn: 七十还是有点高。六十八可以吗？我现在就买。
turns.tip: 用 「Could you make it...」 来还价，加上 「I'll take it right now」 增加说服力。

turns.en: Alright, since you're buying it today, $68 it is.
turns.cn: 好吧，既然您今天就买，那就六十八吧。

turns.en: Great! Do you accept credit cards or only cash?
turns.cn: 太好了！你们收信用卡还是只收现金？
turns.tip: 确认支付方式，可以用 「Do you accept...」 的句型。

turns.en: We accept both. Would you like a bag for it?
turns.cn: 两种都可以。需要给您拿个袋子吗？

turns.en: Yes, please. Thank you for your help!
turns.cn: 好的，麻烦了。谢谢您的帮助！
turns.tip: 礼貌结尾，说 「Thank you for your help」 显得很有教养。

turns.en: Good morning. Do you have an appointment with us today?
turns.cn: 早上好。您今天有预约吗？

turns.en: Yes, my name is Li Wei. I have an appointment at ten o'clock.
turns.cn: 是的，我叫李伟。我预约了十点钟的门诊。
turns.tip: 语气要友好自信，记得使用 have an appointment 这个固定搭配。

turns.en: Thank you. Please fill out this form and sign at the bottom. Do you have your insurance card with you?
turns.cn: 谢谢。请填写这张表格并在底部签名。您带保险卡了吗？

turns.en: Here it is. By the way, should I pay the copay now or later?
turns.cn: 给您。顺便问一下，我现在付自付额还是稍后付？
turns.tip: copay 指挂号自付额，用 Here it is 递东西时非常自然。

turns.en: You can pay the copay now. The doctor will see you in about ten minutes. Please have a seat in the waiting area.
turns.cn: 您现在就可以付自付额。医生大约十分钟后看诊。请在等候区就座。

turns.en: Doctor, I have been having a sore throat and a runny nose since last weekend.
turns.cn: 医生，我从上周末开始喉咙痛还流鼻涕。
turns.tip: 描述症状时可用 have been having + 症状 + since... 来表示持续一段时间。

turns.en: I see. Let me check your throat and listen to your breathing. Please open your mouth and say 「ah」.
turns.cn: 明白了。让我检查一下您的喉咙并听听呼吸。请张嘴说「啊」。

turns.en: Ah—— Is it serious? I have an important meeting tomorrow.
turns.cn: 啊——严重吗？我明天有个重要会议。
turns.tip: 询问病情是否严重可用 Is it serious? 语气可以稍微带点担心。

turns.en: It looks like a common cold. I will write you a prescription for some antibiotics and cough syrup.
turns.cn: 看起来是普通感冒。我会给您开一些抗生素和止咳糖浆的处方。

turns.en: How often should I take them? And can I go to work tomorrow?
turns.cn: 这些药多久吃一次？我明天能去上班吗？
turns.tip: 询问服药频率用 How often should I take...? 是看病非常实用的句型。

turns.en: Take the pills three times a day after meals. I suggest you take one day off to rest and drink plenty of water.
turns.cn: 饭后服药，一天三次。我建议您休息一天，多喝点水。

turns.en: Understood. Thank you very much for your help, Doctor.
turns.cn: 明白了。非常感谢您的帮助，医生。
turns.tip: 结束对话时用 Understood 表示听懂了医嘱，礼貌又简洁。

turns.en: Hello, thank you for calling tech support. My name is David. How may I assist you today?
turns.cn: 您好，感谢您致电技术支持。我叫David。请问有什么可以帮您？

turns.en: Hi David, my laptop cannot connect to the company VPN. It keeps showing an error message.
turns.cn: 你好David，我的笔记本电脑无法连接公司VPN。它一直显示错误信息。
turns.tip: 用平静的语气说明问题，可以说 I'm having trouble with...

turns.en: I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me the exact error code or message displayed on your screen?
turns.cn: 很抱歉听到这个消息。您能告诉我屏幕上显示的确切错误代码或信息吗？

turns.en: It says 「Connection timed out」every time I try to log in.
turns.cn: 每次我尝试登录时，它都显示「连接超时」。
turns.tip: 引用屏幕文字时用 It says...，注意 timed out 的发音。

turns.en: Thank you for that information. Let me check if there is a known server issue on our side. Are you working remotely today?
turns.cn: 感谢您提供的信息。让我查一下我们这边是否有已知的服务器问题。您今天是在远程办公吗？

turns.en: Yes, I am working from home, and my internet connection is stable for video calls and emails.
turns.cn: 是的，我在家办公，而且我的网络连接在视频通话和邮件方面都很稳定。
turns.tip: 强调网络没问题时可用 stable 或 working fine。

turns.en: Understood. Please try restarting the VPN client first. If that does not help, please reinstall the latest version from the company portal.
turns.cn: 明白了。请先尝试重启VPN客户端。如果没用，请从公司门户网站重新安装最新版本。

turns.en: Alright, I will restart it now. Should I contact you again if the problem persists?
turns.cn: 好的，我现在重启。如果问题仍然存在，我应该再次联系您吗？
turns.tip: 礼貌询问后续步骤，可用 Should I... if the problem persists?

turns.en: Yes, please call back or submit a support ticket if the issue continues. Also, check that your firewall is not blocking the application.
turns.cn: 是的，如果问题持续，请回电或提交支持工单。另外，请检查您的防火墙没有阻止该应用程序。

turns.en: Got it. I will check the firewall settings and try reinstalling the software if necessary. Thank you for your guidance.
turns.cn: 明白了。我会检查防火墙设置，必要时尝试重新安装软件。感谢您的指导。
turns.tip: 结束对话时表示感谢，guidance 比 help 更正式一些。

turns.en: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
turns.cn: 不客气。今天我还能帮您什么吗？

turns.en: No, that is all for now. I appreciate your help. Have a great day!
turns.cn: 没有了，暂时就这些。感谢您的帮助。祝您有美好的一天！
turns.tip: 礼貌收尾，说 I appreciate your help 会显得更专业。
